{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''Squib salvage scow''' discovered a copy of the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'' c. [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]]. The book was among artifacts the [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] recovered from the ruins of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. The Squibs handed the volume over to the [[New Jedi Order]] for study.
